-- AzerothCore spawns these dungeon rares only some of the time: a row on AI init despawns them again with a 50-90 %
-- chance. On Ascension they are fixed encounters (all have an `instance_encounters` row, most an Ascension kit), and
-- players miss them in every run that rolls the despawn (#7348 Earthcaller Halmgar, #7349 Blind Hunter).
--  1720 Bruegal Ironknuckle      3586 Miner Johnson           3872 Captain Midwinter       4425 Blind Hunter
--  4842 Earthcaller Halmgar      5912 Brightwing              6228 Dark Iron Ambassador    7354 Ragglesnout
--  8923 Panzor the Invincible    9217 Wizz'Magg the Magus     9218 Razmorg the Decapitator 9219 Chop'gog the Butcher
--  9596 Bannok Grimaxe          10080 Sandarr Dunereaver     10081 Dustwraith            10082 Zerillis
-- 10376 Crystal Fang            10393 Skul                   10509 Jed Runewatcher       10809 Stonespine
-- 11467 Tsu'zee                 12237 Meshlok the Harvester
DELETE FROM `smart_scripts`
    WHERE `source_type` = 0 AND `id` = 0 AND `event_type` = 37 AND `action_type` = 41
      AND `entryorguid` IN (1720, 3586, 3872, 4425, 4842, 5912, 6228, 7354, 8923, 9217, 9218, 9219, 9596, 10080,
                            10081, 10082, 10376, 10393, 10509, 10809, 11467, 12237);

{
  "schema": 1,
  "name": "Mythic+ Blackrock Depths: a Ring of Law arena boss clears Ring of Law",
  "contract": "In a Blackrock Depths Prison keystone run, killing Hedrum the Creeper (one of the six arena bosses) sends that boss's own encounter 2986 in the progress packet, as the client lists each arena boss with its own final encounter (DungeonEncounterExtra.dbc 2981-2986 for lfg 2030) and its tracker expects.",
  "timeout_ms": 90000,
  "location": { "map": 0, "x": -8914.0, "y": -133.0, "z": 80.6 },
  "players": [
    { "id": "hero", "race": 1, "class": 1, "level": 60 }
  ],
  "steps": [
    { "action": "wait", "ms": 1000 },
    { "action": "set_health", "actor": "hero", "value": 5000000, "maximum": 5000000 },
    { "action": "ascension_dungeon_difficulty_packet", "actor": "hero", "value": 2 },
    { "action": "wait", "ms": 250 },
    { "action": "teleport", "actor": "hero", "map": 230, "x": 458.32, "y": 26.52, "z": -70.67 },
    { "action": "wait", "ms": 1500 },
    { "action": "wait", "ms": 300 },
    { "action": "add_item", "actor": "hero", "item": 400326, "count": 1 },
    { "action": "use_item", "actor": "hero", "item": 400326, "spell": 161 },
    { "action": "assert", "label": "CONTROL: socket window", "actor": "hero", "metric": "server_packets", "opcode": 2310, "equals": 1, "within_ms": 1000 },
    { "action": "client_packet", "actor": "hero", "opcode": 1319 },
    { "action": "wait", "ms": 10500 },
    { "action": "summon", "actor": "hero", "entry": 9032, "as": "hedrum", "distance": 4 },
    { "action": "wait", "ms": 300 },
    { "action": "attack_nearby", "actor": "hero", "entry": 9032, "kill": true },
    { "action": "wait", "ms": 500 },
    { "action": "assert", "label": "progress: one encounter", "actor": "hero", "metric": "server_packet_u32", "opcode": 2313, "index": 0, "equals": 1 },
    { "action": "assert", "label": "progress: it is Hedrum the Creeper", "actor": "hero", "metric": "server_packet_u32", "opcode": 2313, "index": 1, "equals": 2986 }
  ]
}
